verdict.rationale: Paxos documents its settlement rails: wire (Fedwire/SWIFT) and CUBIX for USD, plus settling USD directly to a bank account. A List Transfers API and webhook events with an event-replay API give accounting a programmatic feed of money movement. Settlement timing is only vaguely described as 'near-instant' for PYUSD, and no fee schedule appears. Missing for 10: documented payment-to-available-balance timing per rail, published fees per rail, downloadable statements or accounting-ready reports.
